The teacher's corrections on this scene:

The system's item in each run:

Run 2: Coherence (Reference): 他的城市：自己的城市，when the possessor is the same person as the subject, 自己的 makes that relationship clear. [teacher rule: ziji_possessor]
Run 3: Coherence (Reference): 他很喜欢他的城市：他很喜欢自己的城市，When the subject and possessor are the same person, 自己的 makes the relationship clear and avoids a possible reading that the city belongs to another male person. [teacher rule: ziji_possessor]

output.reason: All runs identify the same pronoun-possessor ambiguity and correctly replace 他的城市 with 自己的城市.
